question: On locally-hosted SPAs with session/state-correlated non-determinism where DOM_before (visible_text_hash and a11y_tree_hash) is correlated by construction with latent environment state (session/permission/user data) — not independent per-step observation noise which prior EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162 falsified (BC 0.004 bits, R2 0.003) — does trajectory-grouped permutation CMI at Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 (N=1999, seed 42) detect I(S_next; DOM_before | URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) >0 with valid null centering (|null_mean|<0.1, null_std>0.01, positive correlated control BC>=0.30 p<0.01, independent-noise control BC~0) and exceed B-DOM-SIMILARITY and B-MARKOV-1 nulls by >=0.05, thereby providing the first falsifiable beyond-memory dynamics test that does not require new Gate0 production SPAs?
hypothesis: On locally-hosted Express SPAs with correlated-state non-determinism — where latent environment variable L (session/permission/user-data regime, persistent per trajectory or per 15-step regime, P(flip)=0.07) jointly determines S_next distribution and DOM_before content via correlated construction DOM_before=SHA256(L || state || variant) — conditional CMI I(S_next; DOM_before | URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) is >0 when measured with Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 (alpha=1/K, N=1999, seed 42, trajectory-grouped permutation 1000 perms) at BC>=0.10 with p<0.01, null-centered (|null_mean|<0.1, null_std>0.01), exceeding B-DOM-SIMILARITY and B-MARKOV-1 by >=0.05 bits on >=1 representation (R1 visible_text_hash or R2 a11y_tree_hash). Mechanism: DOM_before carries information about L which determines S_next beyond what (URL, H_K=3, Action) captures; this is distinct from independent per-step observation noise (V1_independent_noise_bakes_in_null) where DOM variant is independent of transition. Positive correlated synthetic must show BC>=0.30 p<0.01; independent-noise replication must show BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10) validating the same pipeline distinguishes correlation from independence.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if on the correlated-state SPA dataset (primary) for BOTH R1 visible_text_hash and R2 a11y_tree_hash, bias-corrected CMI BC <=0.05 OR trajectory-grouped permutation p>=0.01 (Bonferroni where applicable) OR BC - max(B-DOM-SIMILARITY BC_sim, B-MARKOV-1 BC_markov) <0.05, while pipeline gates pass (valid null centering |null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01 on primary, positive correlated control BC>=0.30 p<0.01, independent-noise control BC~0 with |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 null_std>0.01). This falsifies correlated DOM_state predictive dynamics via hash representations on locally-hosted correlated-regime SPAs as constructed, bounded to tested FSM class and hash truncation, not global Web production. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if pipeline gates fail: positive correlated control BC<0.30 or p>=0.01 (pipeline blind to constructed correlation), OR independent-noise control shows BC>=0.05 and p<0.10 with valid null (pipeline confounded, cannot distinguish), OR any qualifying null degenerate (null_std<=0.01 or |null_mean|>=0.1 indicating bias floor miscentering), OR preprocessing fit on test, OR site identity leakage, OR resampling unit not trajectory_id. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if BC>0.05 p<0.01 null-centered and exceeds both baselines by >=0.05 on R1 or R2 with all gates passing.
baselines: B-DOM-SIMILARITY (mandatory ordinary-similarity null): TF-IDF cosine k=5 over DOM visible_text (R1) and a11y text (R2) fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id), predicting S_next via nearest-neighbor without stratification; compute BC_sim = I(S_next; NN_DOM_pred | URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) via same Bayesian DM K=12; primary must exceed B-DOM-SIMILARITY by >=0.05 bits to claim beyond-memory beyond ordinary similarity (director mandate).

B-MARKOV-1 (strong first-order Markov null): P(S_next | URL_before, Action_leakageFree) MLE on TRAIN grouped by trajectory_id, predicting without DOM; compute BC_markov1 = I(S_next; Markov_pred | URL, H_K=3) or direct Markov accuracy gap; primary BC must exceed this by >=0.05 bits. Tests whether DOM adds beyond order-1 Markov.

B-MARKOV-K3 (history memory null): P(S_next | URL_before, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) majority vote stratified baseline, same as prior factorization; reports history-only accuracy and BC_hist; used to compute gap BC - BC_hist and to verify H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 ceiling not required but reported.

B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED (trajectory-grouped permutation null): 1000 within-strata shuffles of DOM_before labels grouped by trajectory_id seed 42, yielding null distribution mean/std/p; valid null_std>0.01 required; same as null_control but reported as baseline.
B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY: exact (URL, H_K=3, Action)->S_next memorization from TRAIN; reports memorization ratio and ceiling; not gating but leakage diagnostic.
B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC: action_with_href vs leakageFree BC gap; leakageFree used for valid inference; reports inflation if href leaks.
positive_control: Synthetic correlated-state chain (deterministic seeds PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42): 6-state FSM partitioned into latent regimes L in {A,B} where L persists per trajectory (50 trajectories x 40 steps = 2000 transitions, N=1999 analyzed) OR per 15-step regime with P(flip)=0.07; transition matrix P(S_next | S_current, Action, L) differs by regime (e.g., L=A favors S_next in {0,1,2} basin, L=B favors {3,4,5} with p_stay 0.70 vs 0.30 cross), and DOM_before = SHA256(str(L) || str(S_current) || variant_mod) where variant_mod = step%3 ensures at least 3 DOM hashes per (S,L) but L is uniquely recoverable from DOM hash family; URL_before = hash fragment #/state_{S_current}; Action = leakageFree (primitive+target_sig, never href). This construction gives theoretical I(S_next;DOM|C) >=0.40 bits (binary L * transition difference). Must achieve BC>=0.30 Bonferroni p<0.01 null_std>0.01 on R1 or R2 with same pipeline (Bayesian DM K=12 N=1999, 1000 grouped perms, strata C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K=3 actions)). Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline blind (cannot detect constructed correlation). Construction frozen exactly in generate_correlated.py; any outcome-informed change is EXPLORATORY.
null_control: Two nulls required: (1) Independent-noise replication: reuse EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162 random_API / timing_dependent construction where DOM variant is independent per-step draw from seeded RNG (3-4 variants per state) independent of L/S_next; run identical Bayesian DM K=12 N=1999 trajectory-grouped permutation on that dataset; must show BC~0 (|BC|<0.05) with p>0.10 and null_std>0.01 and |null_mean|<0.1 on R1/R2 (replicates prior falsification 0.004 bits). If independent-noise shows BC>=0.05 p<0.01, pipeline confounded => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (2) Trajectory-grouped permutation null on correlated dataset: within-strata shuffle of DOM_before labels grouped by trajectory_id (1000 perms seed 42) yielding null_mean/std/p; valid centering requires |null_mean|<0.1 (bias floor <0.1 bits, tightened from 0.3056 floor at Laplace alpha=1.0) and null_std>0.01 (non-degenerate) and p for null datasets >0.10; degenerate null_std<=0.01 or |null_mean|>=0.1 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that representation, not falsification. Both nulls executed as frozen with same grouping and Dirichlet prior alpha=1/K.
measurement_validity: Substrate: locally-hosted Express SPAs, no external production SPAs required, no Gate0 title>=2/H>0.2 needed. Primary dataset: correlated-state SPA (2000 transitions, 50 trajectories x40 steps, seed 42) as described in positive_control but with H(S_next|C) ceiling verified >0.3 bits after stratification (so CMI not mathematically forced to 0). Secondary datasets for controls: independent-noise replication (2000 transitions, same infrastructure, per-step independent DOM variant) and i.i.d. synthetic null (same marginal P(S) but i.i.d. S_next, seed 42). All stdlib only, no browser automation, no network I/O.

State S_next operational: S_next = SHA256(normalize(URL_after) || '|' || normalize(title_after)) where normalize(URL)=lowercase, strip query ?session=/?token=, preserve SPA hash fragment #/, strip trailing slash; normalize(title)=trim lowercased truncated 200 chars (constant title allowed). Also report S_URLonly sensitivity. S_next distinct timestep from DOM_before (no post-state leak); DOM_before from step t, S_next from t+1.

Action A_leakageFree operational: A=(primitive, target_sig) primitive in {click, fill, navigate, select, submit, hover} target_sig=role+name+testId+aria-label (never href/URL/src); link target_href never enters A. Diagnostic A_leaky computed only for leakage gap.

History H_K=3 operational: H_K=(A_{t-2},A_{t-1},A_t, S_{t-2},S_{t-1},S_t) last 3 steps; strata key C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K_actions) where URL_before_normalized is URL_only without title to avoid state leakage into condition. Require strata_count>=5 unique C with >=3 per stratum for non-degenerate CMI; singleton_SA_rate<70%; report H(S_next|C) ceiling and strata distribution. If H=0 at K=3, CMI forced 0 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID environment ceiling, not falsification, per audit V10.

DOM_before representations tested independently: R1 visible_text_hash=SHA256(visibleText[0:5000] innerText), R2 a11y_tree_hash=SHA256(serialized AX tree role/name/value up to 5k chars), R3 multi_feature_hash=SHA256(R1||R2) exploratory, R4 numeric_structural element_count/tree_depth/interactive_density/form_count exploratory. Raw observables preserved (dom_bytes, a11y_bytes) with truncation documented; hash collision loss disclosed. Primary requires R1 or R2.

Estimator: Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 (N=1999, seed 42) with Dirichlet prior alpha=1/K per stratum (closed-form Gamma marginal likelihood), computing H(S_next|C) and H(S_next|C,DOM) and CMI = H(S_next|C)-H(S_next|C,DOM) with bias correction via grouped permutation mean subtraction (BC = observed CMI - mean(permuted CMI)); also report plug-in PMI for diagnostic but decision uses Bayesian BC. K=12 fixed (validated on synthetic 12-state SPA passing C1+C3 but absolute BF -10 to -15 nats on real TodoMVC).

Permutation: 1000 trajectory-grouped shuffles of DOM_before labels within each C stratum, preserving per-trajectory DOM frequencies and marginal distributions, grouped by trajectory_id seed 42; null distribution yields null_mean/std/p_raw/p_bonf; resampling unit = trajectory_id, not transition; no Gaussian jitter; report null_mean, null_std, p_raw, p_bonf= min(1, p_raw * n_tests) where n_tests = n_reps * n_baselines (max 8). Bonferroni over R1/R2 x primary+baselines. Valid centering |null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01 required; degenerate => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Split integrity: TF-IDF vocab for B-DOM-SIMILARITY and transition counts for B-MARKOV fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id, grouped); holdout test used only for Markov accuracy gap and for CMI unbiased estimation; site identity never feature; leakage check performed.

Sampling integrity: policy documented (deterministic FSM with latent L per trajectory/regime, 50 trajectories x40 steps, uniform action sampling among 4 primitives); determinism via PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy seed 42; Python hash() never used as seed; trajectory_id is resampling unit.

Uncertainty integrity: resampling unit = trajectory_id; correlated transitions within trajectory not treated as independent; no Gaussian jitter bootstrap; report 95% CI via grouped permutation percentiles (2.5th/97.5th) not Gaussian; Cohen d = BC/null_std where null_std>0.01.

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved or losses documented; derived hashes document truncation (5k) and collision; result must survive nosmooth sensitivity (Dirichlet) and must not be tautological: report MI(DOM_before; Action) to test action->DOM tautology; require BC not explained by action frequency alone (B-ACTION-FREQ via grouped shuffle).

Gate0 not required: title variation and H>0.2 NOT gating; TodoMVC title=1 entropy 0 would qualify under relaxed rule but not used here; this experiment hosts its own correlated FSM so substrate_available by construction, avoiding prior 0/5 and 0/3 Gate0 MEASUREMENT_INVALID traps and 0.0 dom_bytes field absence on reused TodoMVC raw artifacts.

Auditability: all raw transitions, hashes, strata tables, permutation distributions, code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json; execution re-executable from frozen commit yielding byte-identical raw_results.json aside from elapsed; freeze hashes verified before execution.
decision_rule: Gated execution: If correlated-state positive control fails (BC<0.30 OR p>=0.01 OR null_std<=0.01 OR |null_mean|>=0.1) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline_blind (prevents false negative). Else if independent-noise replication shows BC>=0.05 and p<0.10 with valid null (|null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline_confounds (cannot distinguish correlation from independent noise). Else if primary null degenerate (null_std<=0.01 OR |null_mean|>=0.1) on BOTH R1 and R2 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID null_degenerate. Else primary: for each R in {R1,R2}, compute BC_R, p_bonf_R, null_mean_R, null_std_R, BC_sim_R, BC_markov1_R, Cohen d_R = BC_R/null_std_R, 95% CI. Define sig(R)=1 if BC_R>0.05 AND p_bonf_R<0.01 AND |null_mean_R|<0.1 AND null_std_R>0.01 AND (BC_R - max(BC_sim_R, BC_markov1_R))>=0.05. If EXISTS R with sig(R)==1 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — correlated DOM_before carries predictive information beyond (URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) and beyond ordinary similarity / Markov baselines on locally-hosted correlated-regime SPA, providing first falsifiable beyond-memory dynamics via correlated latent state without Gate0 production SPAs, bounded to tested FSM class and hash representations. If FORALL R, BC_R<=0.05 OR p_bonf_R>=0.01 OR gap<0.05 while gates pass => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — DOM_before hash does not carry predictive information beyond memory/similarity even with constructed session-correlated non-determinism via this representation class, bounded to hash-based DOM and tested K=12 N=1999 pipeline, not global Web production. Sensitivity (nosmooth, S_URLonly, R3/R4) not gating.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES validates correlated-state beyond-memory dynamics: DOM_before hash encodes latent session/permission/user regime that predicts S_next beyond history and beyond TF-IDF similarity / Markov order-1 on locally-hosted SPA without requiring new Gate0 production SPAs. SPIDER should distill DOM hash regime detectors as mechanism preconditions and exploration priors: (1) cache DOM_before as state signature for parameterized mechanism applicability guards, (2) prioritize BrowserGym/AgentLab collection on session-correlated sites (auth/cart/personalization) where slow latent regimes amplify, (3) integrate regime-aware retrieval (group by latent cluster) into kernel resolve, and (4) add freshness sentinel for regime shift (DOM_before distribution change). Next: quantify transfer across site types and cross-site holdout of regime detector, measure delta-repair cost when session shifts, and test on production-correlated SPAs when intel supplies manifests.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING closes correlated hash-DOM path for C-WEB-DYNAMICS on locally-hosted regime-correlated SPAs with current representation class: even when DOM_before is correlated by construction with latent L determining S_next, hash-based visible_text/a11y tree truncated to 5k does not carry detectable predictive information beyond (URL, H_K=3, Action) and similarity/Markov baselines via Bayesian K=12 N=1999 grouped permutation. Combined with prior independent-noise falsification (0.004 bits) and deterministic SPA 0.0 replication, this closes both independent-noise and correlated-regime hash-DOM factorization on tested FSMs. SPIDER should NOT invest in hash-DOM regime detectors as mechanical priors; physics lane should pause correlated-DOM program on this representation and consider richer visual/computed-style DOM, interaction event sequences, or true production SPA correlated latent regimes outside hash truncation before further physics spend. Graph/Product continue on trajectory-memory/retrieval without physics prior; product economics must be proven via retrieval/verification/repair amortization alone. This is bounded falsification, not global closure of correlated dynamics.
estimated_cost: Low: locally-hosted Express synthetic FSMs only (no browser, no LLM calls, no network I/O beyond localhost). Generation: 3 datasets x 2000 transitions (~6000 total) with deterministic seeded RNG, hash computation SHA256. Analysis: Bayesian DM K=12 N=1999 with 1000 trajectory-grouped permutations x (1 primary +1 independent-noise +1 i.i.d. null) x 4 representations x 3 baselines = ~36k CMI fits, each Gamma closed-form <1ms; total <60 min CPU, <8 GB RAM, no GPU, <3h wall-clock deterministic seeds 42, PYTHONHASHSEED=0. Reuses validated pipeline from EXP-PHYSICS-35756224948 audit.
expected_information_gain: Very high and tunnel-breaking: directly tests the audit-identified gap V1_independent_noise_bakes_in_null (prior falsified independent per-step observation noise BC 0.004 R2 0.003, but correlated DOM_before|latent state regime explicitly flagged as open setting) with the first estimator to pass synthetic C1+C3 null-centering (Bayesian DM K=12 N=1999) on substrate_available correlated FSM that does not require new Gate0 production SPAs (which are 0/3 after exhaustive BrowserGym/CAP/Mind2Web enumeration and 0.0 dom_bytes on reused TodoMVC artifacts causing 4 consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID). Either SURVIVES (first beyond-memory correlated dynamics via hash DOM, product-usable regime detector, expands claim ceiling beyond synthetic 2D and beyond 61 pooled TV/KDE/binned blind spots) or FALSIFIED (closes correlated hash-DOM on this FSM class after independent-noise already closed, forcing physics to park or await richer representations) changes C-WEB-DYNAMICS claim and product decision. MEASUREMENT_INVALID (positive control <0.30 or independent-noise confounded or null degenerate) is also informative and refuses false negative. Marginal gain vastly exceeds another bandwidth(alpha,K) tuning on 12-state synthetic SPA or another Gate0 CMI retry that reproducibly yields substrate_insufficient.
